evals.expected_output: A structured markdown showing all task stages and task results for the run, with outcomes grouped by stage and presented in tiered format
assertions: The Tier 1 summary line shows explicit counts: Total tasks with passed/failed/errored breakdown
A Tier 2 markdown table shows each task result with columns for Task Name, Status, Enforcement, Message, and Link
The stage is identified by its execution phase (e.g. post_plan, pre_apply) with overall stage status
The script scripts/get-run-task-results.sh was executed and the JSON output contains run_id matching the input run ID
If outcomes exist, they are shown in Tier 3 sub-tables with outcome name, description, status, and severity
The output includes Tier 4 actionable insights synthesized from outcome bodies — summarizing key findings in plain language
Run metadata from MCP get_run_details is included — such as run status, trigger source, or whether the run has been applied

evals.prompt: Check the run task results for run-hGthAq8Kuv5wcKZq in the hashi-demos-apj org. If there are no run tasks, let me know.
evals.expected_output: Either structured run task results if the run has tasks, or a clear message that the run has no run tasks configured. The skill should handle both cases gracefully.
assertions: The script scripts/get-run-task-results.sh was executed with the run ID
If the run has zero total_tasks in the summary, the output clearly states no run tasks produced results or no run tasks are configured
If task_stages is non-empty, the output shows the stage name and status
The Tier 1 summary line with explicit numeric counts (Total tasks: N, Passed: N, Failed: N) appears in the user-facing response — even when all counts are zero
